seam.cause: Tonal differences already present in registered source TCI tiles from the same datatake; not introduced by our global colour correction. No missing coverage at the seam. Exact upstream radiometric/atmospheric cause not established.

processing: Same verified TCI B04/B03/B02 sources; north/south same-location smoothstep blending over 4000m of genuine overlap, then the existing restrained global colour correction. No spatial smoothing or geography changes. 64km square context crop keeps the patch boundary outside the destination camera.
